knowledge.title: The Antioch look, step by step
knowledge.description: Start here: which Design Lessons govern each step of proposing or critiquing a Mission's look, how much each weighs, and the leading words they use.

knowledge.title: Design Lessons
knowledge.description: The ratified Design Lessons DL-01 to DL-19: each rule, the measured evidence and frames behind it, its weight and the Blueprint hook it shapes.

knowledge.title: Choosing textures
knowledge.description: How to fill a Blueprint's texturePalette, and a texture set's palette past 8 textures: the palette's slots, pads of built ground, and how to search the texture catalog.

knowledge.title: Choosing cliffs
knowledge.description: How to fill a Blueprint's cliffPalette and cliffSets: a cliff family chosen with the ground it borders, per map or per area, and how to search the cliff catalog.

knowledge.title: Dressing
knowledge.description: Cliff piles, edge lines and what makes an edge read right, shore dressing, set pieces and Doodad Composites (captured or composed), how to search the doodad catalog, and how to take dressing feedback.

knowledge.title: Interiors
knowledge.description: Dressing a built room (factory, lab, prison, ship's deck): target densities by room type, where things go, the order to dress in, the kits that make a room read as working, and what never stands alone.

knowledge.title: Lighting
knowledge.description: Lighting a Mission from its mood: its own lights, Beat transitions, and point lights in dark places (night, interiors, caves, void).

knowledge.title: Sky
knowledge.description: Setting a Mission's skybox, fog and open sky through the Blueprint's sky.

knowledge.title: Water
knowledge.description: Filling pits with water or lava, raising them at a Beat, and dressing their shores.

knowledge.title: Terrain objects
knowledge.description: Built pieces that reshape the ground (bridges, pits, trenches, craters, elevators), placed through the Blueprint's terrainObjects.

knowledge.title: Mood mixtures
knowledge.description: How the Exemplar Maps' dressed places group into moods, and how to dress a new place from its mood's mixture instead of copying a layout.

knowledge.title: Mood mixtures (data)
knowledge.description: Every dressed place on the independent Exemplar Maps with its mood, and each mood's motifs, type count, density, spacing and snapping.

knowledge.title: Exemplar data analysis
knowledge.description: The measurements behind the Design Lessons, with corrections, counterexamples and open questions.

knowledge.title: About the Exemplar Maps
knowledge.description: What each Exemplar Map's folder holds, how Map Studies and captures are made, and how lessons are ratified.

prompts.name: add-exemplar-map
prompts.title: Add an Exemplar Map to the Antioch Style Pack
prompts.description: Walks through adding a map to the Antioch Style Pack: recording its provenance, studying and capturing it, and bringing each new or changed Design Lesson to the author.

arguments.name: id
arguments.description: A short id for the map, such as 4-1

arguments.name: map
arguments.description: The map's path inside the Workspace's Exemplar Map folder

arguments.name: provenance
arguments.description: made, edited or approved (a map the author admires)
